target: APG disclosure button state and keyboard interactions
observed_behavior: The APG Disclosure (Show/Hide) pattern describes a button controlling a content section whose visibility toggles between collapsed and expanded. With focus on the disclosure button, Enter and Space activate it and toggle controlled content. It specifies button semantics and aria-expanded=true when the content is visible and false when hidden. It describes aria-controls referencing the controlled content as optional, not required; a directional arrow/triangle may be used as a visual indication.
context: W07 B3 K3 read-only APG About This Pattern; Keyboard Interaction; WAI-ARIA Roles, States, and Properties; first-party non-normative explanatory guidance, bounded to qualified APG pattern and exceptions.
limitations: This is APG guidance for disclosure interactions, not a claim that every show/hide design requires aria-controls or a particular arrow icon.
aria-controls is explicitly optional in this pattern; aria-expanded must match the disclosure state in the documented interaction model.
No modal dialog, focus trap or automatically moving focus into revealed content is prescribed by this disclosure page.
